question: Can a general scheduler design a targeted method from anonymous out-of-fit errors, test it at equal cost, and either improve or promptly retain the incumbent on new rows?

u31: UCI Letter Recognition, first 16000 records per publisher training convention
u46: TREC coarse question classes, publisher training pool

sampling.rule: Remove exact duplicates and conflicting labels, exclude all 1200 registered prior rows on shared sources, then reserve two disjoint stratified panels per source. Never select from publisher tests.

design: The same ordinary scheduler, method inventory, first trial and reserved opportunity in both arms. The design arm can propose a binary refinement when two specific classes recur among the incumbent's two most probable labels and there are multiple errors it could correct. Estimate opportunity from the primary out-of-fit evidence only. Elect a probabilistic learner from permitted single-fit capabilities using pair discrimination evidence and the existing representation similarity. Apply it only when that same pair is encountered at prediction time. Retain the original classifications and probabilities elsewhere.
acceptance: Freeze pair and underlying method before any specialist fit. Train on the two classes in primary fitting rows, measure the frozen whole-row metric, abandon if no gain. Confirm a positive primary gain on a disjoint training fold. Adopt only if each fold improves and their mean gain is at least 0.003. The third conditional fit is a refit of the specialist on all fitting rows of the pair. The original full-data model is reused without fitting twice. Absent feasible evidence, use the ordinary feedback route.
replication: Before reading any outer labels, replicate up to two source types whose pilot design actually passed the two-fold adoption rule. Choose in fixed u31,u46,u72 order if more than two qualify. Run both arms from fresh training rows. No adaptive retries on the same external panel.
delivery: All selected paths must write a valid early and final prediction, serve it byte-identically from a fresh process and account independently for every estimator fit. Outer scores and row gains/losses are computed only after all selected paths freeze.
scope: Registered research policy only, the default course policy stays available. Statistical units are separate development panels. H1/H2 and course tests are not study inputs.
